pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the best way to respond when someone teases you about your appearance? (1 mark)
   A. Tease them back
   B. Stop going to school
   C. Change your name
   D. Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues

2. Why does no other person have the same fingerprints as you? (1 mark)
   A. Fingerprints are drawn at birth
   B. Fingerprints change every day
   C. Only twins have fingerprints
   D. Every person is unique

3. Why is it good to name your feeling, such as saying "I am angry"? (1 mark)
   A. It helps you to decide what to do about it
   B. It is a sin
   C. It makes the feeling bigger
   D. It makes others angry

4. Which commandment says, "Honour your father and your mother"? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:12
   B. Exodus 20:16
   C. Exodus 20:3
   D. Exodus 20:15

5. Which of these is a safe touch? (1 mark)
   A. A touch you have been told to keep secret
   B. A hug from a parent
   C. A touch that scares you
   D. Touching your private parts by a stranger

6. What does "holy" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pure, perfect and set apart
   B. Fast
   C. Old
   D. Rich

7. Which is a poetry and wisdom book in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. Exodus
   C. Psalms
   D. Isaiah

8. Which of these is an honest use of money? (1 mark)
   A. Lying about the price
   B. Stealing from a friend
   C. Cheating in a game
   D. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper

9. What did the angel tell Balaam to do at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Go home forever
   B. Kill the donkey
   C. Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   D. Curse Israel

10. How can a child trust God when facing a challenge? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Give up
   C. Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   D. Ignore the problem

11. What did Samson use to kill the lion? (1 mark)
   A. A sword
   B. A stone
   C. A spear
   D. His bare hands

12. Whom did Joseph credit for the interpretation? (1 mark)
   A. God
   B. The cupbearer
   C. Himself
   D. The magicians

13. In which town did Mary live? (1 mark)
   A. Nazareth
   B. Bethlehem
   C. Jericho
   D. Nain

14. Which quality of Mary should we copy? (1 mark)
   A. Trust in God and humility
   B. Greed
   C. Pride
   D. Anger

15. What did the angel tell Zechariah to name the baby? (1 mark)
   A. Gabriel
   B. John
   C. Jesus
   D. Zechariah

16. What did Bartimaeus do when Jesus called him? (1 mark)
   A. Hid
   B. Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   C. Ran away
   D. Stayed sitting

17. Where were the ten men when they called to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Right beside Him
   B. In their homes
   C. At a distance
   D. In the temple

18. Which habit helps to prevent many diseases? (1 mark)
   A. Playing in dirty water
   B. Not bathing
   C. Sharing dirty cups
   D. Washing hands with soap

19. How did the crowd react? (1 mark)
   A. They were filled with awe and praised God
   B. They laughed
   C. They argued
   D. They left in anger

20. Which of these helps God's kingdom grow? (1 mark)
   A. Being unkind
   B. A good example and sharing the good news
   C. Ignoring church
   D. Keeping quiet

21. What did Nicodemus bring to prepare Jesus' body for burial? (1 mark)
   A. Bread
   B. Myrrh and aloes
   C. Gold
   D. Oil only

22. What did Jesus say a person must be born of? (1 mark)
   A. Fire and wind
   B. Water and the Spirit
   C. Earth and sky
   D. Bread and wine

23. Why should we trust God always? (1 mark)
   A. He forgets
   B. He is unknown
   C. He is far
   D. He is loving and faithful

24. What does integrity mean? (1 mark)
   A. Copying others
   B. Doing right when nobody is watching
   C. Being popular
   D. Being lucky

25. Which verse says that God is love? (1 mark)
   A. 1 John 4:8
   B. Luke 19:5
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Acts 2:38

26. What did Jesus overturn in the temple? (1 mark)
   A. The altar
   B. The doors
   C. Tables of the money changers
   D. The windows

27. According to Matthew 10:3, which disciple is listed together with Thaddaeus? (1 mark)
   A. James son of Alphaeus
   B. Andrew
   C. Judas Iscariot
   D. Peter

28. What does "lead us not into temptation" ask? (1 mark)
   A. That God hides us
   B. That God keeps us from doing wrong
   C. That God gives gifts
   D. That God punishes us

29. What does "Amen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Let it be so
   B. Goodbye
   C. Thank you for food
   D. Hello

30. What should you do if someone offers you a harmful drug? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it
   B. Try it
   C. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   D. Sell it

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain how repentance draws a person close to Christ and how a child can repent. (5 marks)

32. Give four benefits of forgiving others. (4 marks)

33. State two choices that you make at home every day. (2 marks)

34. Explain what "born again" means. (2 marks)

35. State two ways of helping the kingdom of God to grow. (2 marks)

36. Give three reasons why children should not join ungodly groups. (3 marks)

37. Explain how to find Luke 19:1-10 in the Bible. (4 marks)

38. Explain the meaning of "Give us today our daily bread". (3 marks)

39. Explain why Joseph said, "I cannot do it, but God will give Pharaoh the answer". (3 marks)

40. Write the first three books of the New Testament in order. (2 marks)

41. Give three ways of living a righteous life. (3 marks)

42. Describe how the early church began. (4 marks)

43. Give three reasons why baptism is important to Christians. (3 marks)

44. Describe how Daniel made a right choice in Babylon and give two lessons a child can learn from him. (5 marks)

45. Why was the widow of Nain in great need? (2 marks)

46. State three ways of thanking God every day. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues
   God's view of you matters more than unkind words.

2. D — Every person is unique
   Fingerprints show that each person is one of a kind.

3. A — It helps you to decide what to do about it
   Naming feelings makes them easier to handle.

4. A — Exodus 20:12
   Exodus 20:12 is the commandment on honouring parents.

5. B — A hug from a parent
   A hug from a parent is safe and loving.

6. A — Pure, perfect and set apart
   God is holy because He never does wrong.

7. C — Psalms
   Psalms, Proverbs and Job are among the poetry and wisdom books.

8. D — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

9. C — Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   God allowed him to go but ordered him to speak only His words.

10. C — Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   Trust in God shows in prayer and seeking help.

11. D — His bare hands
   He tore it apart with his bare hands.

12. A — God
   Joseph said, "God will give Pharaoh the answer."

13. A — Nazareth
   Luke 1:26 says Gabriel came to Nazareth in Galilee.

14. A — Trust in God and humility
   Mary trusted God and called herself the Lord's servant.

15. B — John
   Luke 1:13 says his name would be John.

16. B — Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   He threw off his cloak and came to Jesus.

17. C — At a distance
   They stood at a distance and called out.

18. D — Washing hands with soap
   Clean hands prevent the spread of germs.

19. A — They were filled with awe and praised God
   They said, "A great prophet has appeared."

20. B — A good example and sharing the good news
   We help by our life and words.

21. B — Myrrh and aloes
   John 19:39 says he brought myrrh and aloes.

22. B — Water and the Spirit
   John 3:5 says this.

23. D — He is loving and faithful
   God is reliable.

24. B — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

25. A — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

26. C — Tables of the money changers
   Matthew 21:12 says He overturned the tables.

27. A — James son of Alphaeus
   Matthew 10:3 pairs James son of Alphaeus with Thaddaeus.

28. B — That God keeps us from doing wrong
   We ask protection from temptation.

29. A — Let it be so
   Amen means so be it.

30. C — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

SECTION B
----
31. (5 marks)
   Answer: Sin separates us from God. When we are sorry and turn from wrong, God forgives and we draw near to Him. A child can admit wrong, say sorry to God and others, put things right, and decide to do better with the Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sin separating, 1 for forgiveness, 1 for admitting, 1 for putting right, 1 for deciding to do better.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: Peace, restored friendship, freedom from anger, pleasing God, fewer fights.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit up to 4.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Whether to do chores, to obey parents, to share food, to be kind to siblings. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid choice.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: A new spiritual birth, a fresh start given by God through the Holy Spirit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for new life and 1 for the Holy Spirit.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: Good example, prayer, inviting friends to church, sharing Bible stories.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: They lead to wrong; they can harm us; they pull us from God and family; they ask for secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: Use the contents page to find the book of Luke. Turn to chapter 19. Then find verses 1 to 10 within that chapter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for finding the book, 1 for the chapter, 1 for the verses, 1 for using the contents page.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to give us what we need each day, such as food. We depend on Him and we thank Him for what we have.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for needs, 1 for food or daily, 1 for thanks or dependence.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Joseph knew that wisdom comes from God. He was humble and did not boast. He gave God the honour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wisdom from God, 1 for humility, 1 for honouring God.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct in order, 2 marks for all three correct.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell the truth, obey parents, share, avoid bad company, say sorry, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit came at Pentecost, Peter preached, people asked what to do, Peter told them to repent and be baptised, about three thousand believed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: It shows a decision to follow Jesus; it is a sign of being washed from sin; it joins us to the church; Jesus taught it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: Daniel decided not to defile himself with the king's food and politely asked for permission to eat differently. Lessons: it is good to stay faithful to God even when far from home or when no one is watching; we can stand for what is right politely and respectfully; God blesses those who stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing the decision, 1 for politeness or asking permission, 2 for two lessons, 1 for clear expression.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: She had lost her husband and now her only son, so she had nobody to provide for her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the husband and 1 for the son.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing songs of praise, worship at church, use His gifts well, write a thank-you note.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.
